purpose: Measure full/omitted/single responses of the exact high-threshold states discussed with the user; do not assign training peaks or score classification
required_checks: Verify every selected source member against the original Git bundle before preparation
Reject mismatch of source-state digest, source run ID, base/effective graph revision, frequency or actual LT threshold
Keep the historical Branch selector 2; do not replace it with the reference selector 3
Freeze all jobs before starting native processes
Compare actual retained stimulus timestamps across presentations; planned ISI alone is insufficient
Validate full windows, finite raw soma/channel/LT diagnostics, imported parameters, original target restoration and idle controller
Compare full control with original archived burst before attributing changes to the omitted impulse
Keep all source conditions and numerical/build provenance explicit on reports
Treat global maximum as a full-pattern descriptor; do not use it as an assigned-impulse training certificate
scope_limits: Not recognition evaluation of all target/foil patterns
No claim of linearity or unique pulse attribution from subtraction alone
No automatic resumption of Series D
